nodes.title: the Bravor signature
nodes.statement: The Bravor system concerns objects called vintzams. There are exactly 6 of them: hurnvash, duthsib, drishen, pyryuk, aztka, ovijen. One operation is written :. One relation is written ::, read as "yields to".

nodes.title: the Bravor combination tables
nodes.statement: The value of x : y for every pair of vintzams is fixed by the table of the first operation. The pairs standing in the :: relation are listed in full.

nodes.title: closure under the first operation
nodes.statement: For all vintzams x and y, x : y is again a vintzam.

nodes.title: the system does not have association of the first operation
nodes.statement: It is not the case that: For all vintzams x, y, z: (x : y) : z = x : (y : z).

verification.domain: every tuple of the carrier the axiom quantifies over
verification.method: exhaustive enumeration by the reference implementation

proof.text: Take the case x = duthsib, y = hurnvash, z = duthsib, left = hurnvash, right = duthsib, read straight from the tables.
The two sides of the claim come apart on that case, so the claim cannot hold for every case.
One counterexample is enough. Note that the claim may still hold for many particular objects; what fails is the universal reading.

nodes.title: shenfal vintzams
nodes.statement: A vintzam x is called shenfal when x : x = x.

nodes.title: vintzams that tuwren
nodes.statement: Two vintzams x and y are said to tuwren when x : y = y : x.

nodes.title: reldjen collections
nodes.statement: A collection S of vintzams is reldjen when x : y belongs to S for every pair x, y drawn from S.

nodes.title: the qennyr of a vintzam
nodes.statement: The qennyr of a vintzam x is the collection of vintzams y for which x :: y holds.

nodes.title: the falwren
nodes.statement: The falwren of the system is the collection of vintzams that tuwren with every vintzam.

nodes.title: the vextarn
nodes.statement: The vextarn is the collection of all shenfal vintzams.

nodes.title: the zamsol of a vintzam
nodes.statement: The zamsol of a vintzam x, written [x], is the smallest reldjen collection that contains x.

nodes.title: a nyrmux
nodes.statement: A vintzam f is a nyrmux when f :: y holds for every vintzam y, that is, when the qennyr of f is the whole system.

nodes.title: the vashnyr of a vintzam
nodes.statement: The vashnyr of a vintzam x is the number of vintzams in its zamsol [x].

nodes.title: the ponkorr
nodes.statement: The ponkorr of the system is the collection of vintzams whose vashnyr is largest.

nodes.title: tezreld pairs
nodes.statement: Two distinct vintzams x and y form a tezreld pair when x :: y and y :: x both hold, that is, when each lies in the qennyr of the other.

nodes.title: the zamsol of a vintzam is reldjen
nodes.statement: For every vintzam x, the collection [x] is reldjen.

verification.domain: every object, then every pair inside its span
verification.method: exhaustive enumeration by the reference implementation

proof.text: [x] is built by taking x and closing under :.
Closing under an operation is exactly the sealing condition.
The carrier is finite, so the closure stops after finitely many rounds.

nodes.title: the zamsol is contained in every reldjen collection
nodes.statement: If S is reldjen and contains x, then S contains all of [x].

verification.domain: every sealed collection against every object
verification.method: exhaustive enumeration by the reference implementation

proof.text: Every member of [x] is reached from x by finitely many applications of the operation.
A sealed S containing x is closed under each of those applications.
So each member of [x] is in S, by induction on the number of applications.

nodes.title: a vintzam is shenfal exactly when its vashnyr is one
nodes.statement: x : x = x holds if and only if [x] contains x alone.

verification.domain: every object
verification.method: exhaustive enumeration by the reference implementation

proof.text: If x : x = x then {x} is already closed under :.
So [x] = {x} and the vashnyr is one.
Conversely a span of one object must contain x : x, which is then x.

nodes.title: the vashnyr divides the number of vintzams
nodes.statement: For every vintzam x, the vashnyr of x divides 6.

verification.domain: every object
verification.method: exhaustive enumeration by the reference implementation

proof.text: [x] is a reldjen collection.
Its size is the vashnyr of x.
The claim is that this size always divides 6.

nodes.title: the vextarn is reldjen
nodes.statement: If x and y are both shenfal then so is x : y.

verification.domain: every ordered pair drawn from the ridge
verification.method: exhaustive enumeration by the reference implementation

proof.text: Let x and y be shenfal.
The claim asks whether (x : y) : (x : y) returns x : y.
Whether it does is settled by running the operation table on every such pair.

proof.text: Symmetry would mean y lies in the qennyr of x exactly when x lies in that of y.
